basic_details.job_title: DC Sivasagar Hahchara Mouzadar Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Office of the Deputy Commissioner, Sivasagar (Toji Nabish Branch) (DC Sivasagar) has announced vacancy for the Mouzadar post under its 2026 recruitment notification. Eligible candidates can apply through the offline application mode, submitting the form by hand or as instructed to the Office Chamber, Toji Nabish (Revenue) Branch, District Commissioner's Office, Sivasagar on or before 30 October 2026. The required qualification for this post is passing the Matriculation or equivalent examination, and the pay is provided on a commission basis. Selection is based on the verification of submitted

qualification.details: Educational Qualification: Candidates must have passed the Matriculation or equivalent examination from a recognised board. | Other Eligibility Conditions: Applicants must be permanent residents of Assam. The candidate must belong to the Nazira Revenue Circle area under Sivasagar district where the vacant mouza is situated, as local permanent residency is mandatory. The applicant must be financially sound and capable of providing landed property and fixed cash security as per the prescribed rules of the government. Preference will be given to candidates having prior experience in mouza administration.

and proof of financial soundness and local residency. Preference is given to candidates with prior administrative experience in managing a mouza.

content_sections.heading: DC Sivasagar Mouzadar at a Glance

rows.details: Office of the Deputy Commissioner, Sivasagar (Toji Nabish Branch)

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates must submit their completed applications in the prescribed format along with all required particulars and testimonials to the Office Chamber, Toji Nabish (Revenue) Branch, District Commissioner's Office, Sivasagar on or before 30 October 2026. Applications submitted after this date or without the required documents will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Educational Qualification: Candidates must have passed the Matriculation or equivalent examination from a recognised board. Other Eligibility Conditions: Applicants must be permanent residents of Assam. The candidate must belong to the Nazira Revenue Circle area under Sivasagar district where the vacant mouza is situated, as local permanent residency is mandatory. The applicant must be financially sound and capable of providing landed property and fixed cash security as per the prescribed rules of the government. Preference will be given to candidates having prior experience in mouza administration.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of educational certificates and marksheets starting from Matriculation Proof of permanent residence (Citizenship certificate/Permanent resident certificate) Caste certificate (if applicable) Financial soundness certificates or proof of landed property and cash security as required Documents supporting any prior mouza administration experience (if applicable)

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for the Mouzadar post is conducted through the verification of submitted applications, accompanying documents, and proof of financial soundness and local residency. Preference is given to candidates with prior administrative experience in managing a mouza.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in DC Sivasagar Mouzadar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is exactly 1 vacancy available for the Mouzadar post under the Nazira Revenue Circle.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form is 30 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Mouzadar post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the Matriculation or equivalent examination from a recognised board.

faq.question: Q4. Is prior experience mandatory for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Prior experience is not strictly mandatory, but candidates with prior mouza administration experience will be given preference.

faq.question: Q5. Who is eligible to apply for this post?
faq.answer: Permanent residents of Assam who reside within the local area of the concerned mouza under Nazira Revenue Circle are eligible to apply, provided they meet the financial soundness and security requirements.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay scale or salary for the Mouzadar post?
faq.answer: The Mouzadar is remunerated on a commission basis as per the prescribed rules of the Assam Land and Revenue Regulation 1886.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for DC Sivasagar Mouzadar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates must submit their applications offline along with all required particulars, testimonials, and proof of financial soundness to the Office Chamber, Toji Nabish (Revenue) Branch, District Commissioner's Office, Sivasagar.

faq.question: Q8. What security or financial condition is required for the candidate?
faq.answer: The candidate must be financially sound and capable of providing landed property and fixed cash security as determined by the authorities under the rules.
